name: Risk Management
mission_fa: ارزیابی، برنامهٔ رسیدگی و بازبینی ریسک کیفیت و تداوم عرضهٔ دارو
excluded_scope: Plan existence implying execution or effectiveness

queries.query: PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?scenario ?assessment ?product ?evidence WHERE { t:riskResult l:resultAssessment ?assessment ; l:citesSourceRecord ?evidence . ?assessment l:assessmentScenario ?scenario . ?scenario l:scenarioProduct ?product }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?plan WHERE { ?plan l:planRiskResult t:riskResult . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?a l:implementsRiskPlan ?plan } }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?old ?new ?source ?conclusion WHERE { t:review l:reviewPriorResult ?old ; l:reviewNewResult ?new . ?new l:citesSourceRecord ?source ; l:conclusion ?conclusion }

PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX l: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/four-domain/> PREFIX r: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/refinement/> PREFIX t: <urn:cmpe-lab:> SELECT ?facility WHERE { t:assessment l:assessmentScenario/r:scenarioFacility ?facility }

limits: Selected-signature projection; no proof of entailment preservation outside listed witnesses
Import interfaces are not counted as owned classes
SHACL profile requirements are not global OWL cardinalities
No native OntoUML module export is claimed
Source model semantic decisions, including PROV projection, remain pending

purpose_contract.input: A scoped medicinal product, facility or supply dependency; a documentary source; assessment and optional review occurrences.
purpose_contract.output: Traceable assessment content, a treatment plan, separately evidenced treatment execution, and predecessor/successor review content.
purpose_contract.flow: scenario → assessment → result/evidence → plan; execution references the plan; review connects prior/new results.
questions: What product, facility or dependency is assessed, and which source supports the result?
Which plans have no recorded execution in this dataset?
Which review changed which result and conclusion?

definitions.RiskAssessmentActivity: An occurrence assessing a scoped risk scenario; distinct from its result content.
definitions.RiskTreatmentActivity: An occurrence executing a risk treatment plan; the plan alone does not establish this occurrence.
definitions.RiskTreatmentPlan: An information artifact specifying a proposed treatment response to an assessment result.
definitions.RiskReviewActivity: An occurrence reviewing earlier assessment content and connecting it with new content.

purpose_contract.remaining: Real independent risk assessment/review evidence, treatment effectiveness, agreed temporal semantics and review of event/content boundaries.
